title: Jiva
summary: Jiva calls a repeating sequence of eight efreeti helpers.
overview: Jiva calls a repeating sequence of eight efreeti helpers.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign immediate pickup of each arriving efreeti.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: An efreeti arrives every 30 seconds during combat and attacks a random hate-list target.
The eight-helper sequence loops while the fight continues.
Ten minutes out of combat resets the counter and removes the helpers. Victory creates a planar projection.

notes: Approval E304. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
